lines.text: What do we need to practice today?
How was my live today? I'm a little worried.
I want to improve my live vocals. What should I focus on practicing?
I'm going to review the live performance I did today. Would you like to watch it with me?
Do I need to practice... to speak better... Seems like there's no noise in your heart~! ... It's weird.
I want to engage with my fans more. Can you help me with that?
Does this mean we'll have more time to practice?
All I'm doing is standing here and spacing out... It's kinda nice, actually.
I'm doing a show with Volume and Aria at the Theater today. Do you want to come watch?
This theater is perfect, but the only thing we don't have is an audience. Could you... be our audience?
This place is fantastic. There's much more artistic freedom here than in the Ark.
Producer, will you listen to my music?
Thanks for caring.
That's brilliant producing.
I've grown a little, right?
A gift for me? This is all so sudden... Thank you.
You're a fan of my music, aren't you?
I'll take good care of it.
As a producer, would you be able to produce... something else?
I hope to make a song for you one day.
Whenever I see you, my heart skips a beat. I hope you feel the same way.
It's my turn.
Yes, I'm listening.
Okay, moving out.
Let's start the show.
Everyone shall hear my song.
I'll do my best.
I won't lose, no matter what kind of audience I face.
Ah... I'm going to rest a little.
Just a little more... I can do this.
I'll get back in once my I catch my breath.
Producer!
Everyone, make some noise!
Let's all sing together!
One more song!
Great!
We did it!
Uh.
Ow!
Whoa.
I'm sorry... my best just isn't good enough.
How did I do?
Producer, ready to watch my show?

Whoo boy... I'm as prepared as I'll ever be,
but I'm still nervous at the thought of having a concert.
I'll need your support more than ever today, Producer.

Hard work pays off.
This concert is going to be a huge success.

No matter what stage I get on,
I'm not afraid as long as I'm with you.

Today's concert is for you, Producer.
So be sure to come!

Um... can I make a move first?
I need to go prepare for a show.

Whenever you're around, I feel secure,
like everything will go smoothly.

I want to do a concert rehearsal in the theater...
Would you like to come?

You always manage to find me no matter where I am.
I like that.

I do miss the times when I was practicing in the Outpost.
After all, it made me who I am today.

I'm thrilled to be on a bigger stage.
Please do come to my show, Producer.
I take it this is so I can work even harder?
Thanks for the vote of confidence.
I think my abilities just went up an octave.
I'll prepare a gift for you next time.

When did you even have time to get this?
Thank you so much.

How did you...
I've wanted this for a while now... thanks.

Although I'm more confident than ever,
I think I still need you around.
One day, I will make your heart flutter whenever you listen to my songs.

I wouldn't be who I am without you. 
Thank you.
I'm ready. Let's go.
Go ahead.
Yes. Over there, right?
Let the show begin.
Let's enjoy the show.
With you around, I can do this easy-peasy.
Let's put on a nice show for our audience.
Hah... Don't worry, I'm okay.
I can do it. I'll try harder!
Let's regroup and try again.
Producer!
I've prepared a special song just for you!
Come on, everybody. Sing your hearts out!
Next!
Feeling good!
Shall we continue?
Ow!
Hold on...
Argh!
The show... must go on...
Another successful show!
